known_rules.known_fix_pattern: Check the attached DWARF local-width evidence and calls before experimenting with register temporaries. Preserve x87 and historical flags; never change a frame size or padding to mask a source mismatch.

known_rules.symptom: A file-static to function-static declaration repair changes BSS symbol order and text operands even though expressions are unchanged.
known_rules.known_source_cause: On the locked main CU, moving face into main_menu_callback swaps face and number offsets. On fld_adspot with its locked flags, restoring localFilename scope preserves all emitted contributions.
known_rules.known_fix_pattern: Use the generated STATIC_SCOPE task and preservation gate. If it changes contributions, retain the symbol-offset differences, restore the source and route to a supervisor. Do not force placement or edit instruction expressions to compensate.
